description: Retrieve active/pending sales orders for the farm. Supports startDate and endDate filters (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime format). Requires farmId and apiKey authorization.

endDate.description: Optional end date range filter (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime)

limit.description: Optional max number of orders to return (default 50, max 100)

startDate.description: Optional start date range filter (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime)

status.description: Optional filter: pending, partially_fulfilled, fulfilled, unfulfilled, shipped, etc.

name: get_orders
